# D'Krisna

> Beauty and wellness services in Caravaca de la Cruz, Murcia, Spain.

## Spanish pages

- [Home](https://dkrisna.es/): Overview of the salon and customer reviews.
- [Manicure and pedicure](https://dkrisna.es/manicura/): Nail, brow and lash appointments, prices, durations and booking links.
- [Massages](https://dkrisna.es/masajes/): Massages, facial treatments and wood therapy, with prices, durations and booking links.
- [Location and contact](https://dkrisna.es/ubicacion/): Address, telephone, regular hours and directions.
- [Team](https://dkrisna.es/sobre-nosotros/): The salon team and planning a visit.

## Booking and current information

Follow the booking link beside the desired service. It opens Booksy with that
service selected. Confirm the final appointment details and availability there.
Read prices and business details on the linked pages; they are not duplicated
in this directory. Availability is provided by Booksy, not by this website.
